## Problem / 问题

Describe the user-visible problem or link the issue. Use `Closes #...` only when this PR resolves it.

## Resulting behavior / 改动后的行为

Describe what happens after the change. Keep independent changes in separate PRs.

## Validation / 验证

List the commands actually run and their results. For behavior fixes, include a regression test or explain the manual evidence.

## UI evidence / 界面证据

For UI changes, attach a sanitized screenshot or GIF and state the tested theme, platform and Harness version. Use a fictional sample project.

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Describe configuration, installation identifier, API or persisted preference changes and any required migration. Write “None” when there is no compatibility impact.

## AI assistance / AI 辅助

Disclose substantial AI assistance. The contributor remains responsible for understanding, reviewing and verifying the change.

- [ ] I ran `npm run verify`, or documented exactly which checks were unavailable.
- [ ] I updated affected English and Chinese copy/documentation.
- [ ] Generated `client.js` matches its source; no credentials or machine-local `.tools` files are included.
